title: HELIOFLOOR: analysis code and data for an independent evaluation of Surya's solar flare forecasting
description:
Analysis code, scored model probabilities and a pinned data snapshot for an independent evaluation of the released solar_flares_surya checkpoint of Surya, the 366M-parameter heliophysics foundation model released by NASA and IBM.

Every numeric claim in the accompanying manuscript is recomputed from this archive by verify_paper.py, which prints a pass/fail line per claim and currently reports 161/161. No GPU, no external downloads and no re-inference are required: the scored probabilities and an unmodified snapshot of the official SuryaBench flare CSV files are included.

Licensing: the code is Apache-2.0. Two components are not ours and carry the CC BY 4.0 attribution requirement of the SuryaBench flare dataset (Roy et al.): the label column in probs_*.csv and the redistributed snapshot in data/flare/, which is unmodified and documented with upstream revision and checksums in data/flare/PROVENANCE.md.
